# tests/fixtures/media

Licensed/generated media fixtures for the worker/inspector test matrix: portrait, landscape,
rotated, VFR, silent, multiple audio tracks, SDR/HDR, corrupted and near-limit files (per
`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` "Output verification"). No fixture is committed yet. Any fixture added here
must be either self-generated (e.g. via FFmpeg synthetic test sources) or explicitly licensed for
redistribution — never a copyrighted clip pulled from the internet.
